inspiration.observed_pattern: A telemetry feature query computes multiple grouped statistics over conditionally selected readings, including AVG, STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN ...), MIN, and MAX for a bounded sensor category and time window.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: The source's PostgreSQL interval-bounded self-join is reauthored as a deterministic grouped sensor profile. New machines, measurement names, values, and quality flags select usable readings through CASE expressions; MariaDB evaluates conditional population standard deviations alongside means and extrema without nondeterministic time functions.

fixture_notes: Only usable voltage readings contribute to the voltage statistics; rejected voltage readings are excluded by CASE. Alpha has usable voltage values 10, 12, and 14 plus a rejected 100, while beta has usable voltage values 20 and 24. Temperature statistics exercise a second conditional population standard deviation.
determinism_notes: Machine labels, measurement kinds, quality flags, numeric values, conditional predicates, grouping key, and final ordering are fixed. No current time, interval arithmetic, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE sensor_readings (reading_id INT PRIMARY KEY, machine_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, reading_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, quality_flag VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, reading_value DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT machine_code, AVG(CASE WHEN reading_kind = 'voltage' AND quality_flag = 'usable' THEN reading_value ELSE NULL END) AS voltage_mean, STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN reading_kind = 'voltage' AND quality_flag = 'usable' THEN reading_value ELSE NULL END) AS voltage_stddev, MIN(CASE WHEN reading_kind = 'voltage' AND quality_flag = 'usable' THEN reading_value ELSE NULL END) AS voltage_min, MAX(CASE WHEN reading_kind = 'voltage' AND quality_flag = 'usable' THEN reading_value ELSE NULL END) AS voltage_max, STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN reading_kind = 'temperature' AND quality_flag = 'usable' THEN reading_value ELSE NULL END) AS temperature_stddev FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY machine_code ORDER BY machine_code

checks.sql: SELECT reading_id, machine_code, reading_kind, quality_flag, reading_value FROM sensor_readings ORDER BY reading_id
